name: NVIDIA VFlash drafts visual plans in one pass
title: NVIDIA VFlash drafts visual plans in one pass
summary: VFlash uses a lightweight diffusion model to predict trajectories, bounding boxes, and 3D motion together instead of one coordinate at a time. The writeup says planning latency falls by about 80%, and on MolmoSpaces robot task success rises from 62.6% to 70.2% when an action model uses those plans.
